subject.title: Telegram: ForceReply prompt for the argument when an args-requiring command is tapped from the menu with no argument

question: Should Telegram missing-argument prompts be an opt-in command metadata contract, inferred from existing `acceptsArgs`/`captureRemaining` specs, or deferred in favor of current usage strings?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the permanent API shape affects shared command metadata and which existing bare commands change behavior.

options.title: Opt-in metadata plus Telegram ForceReply
options.body: Add a command-level missing-argument prompt marker and have Telegram render ForceReply only for commands that explicitly request it.

options.title: Infer from argument specs
options.body: Treat required or captureRemaining arguments as promptable on Telegram, which is simpler but risks changing commands whose bare form is intentionally useful.

options.title: Keep usage fallback
options.body: Leave current usage-string behavior in place and continue using `argsMenu` only for finite-choice commands.

recommendation.title: Opt-in metadata plus Telegram ForceReply
recommendation.body: Add a command-level missing-argument prompt marker and have Telegram render ForceReply only for commands that explicitly request it.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent history place this person closest to the affected command registry and Telegram native command menu code.
